isolation: Four candidate modules override pinned installed helpers. All databases, provider rows and artifacts are temporary fixture data. Relay and ERP use boundary doubles. No full application startup, live database, network/provider invocation, recovery or deployment.
expected_fixture_errors: TimeoutError and rejected evidence messages are deliberate negative cases; the complete 18-test suite returned zero failures, errors and skips.
terminal_timestamp_qualification: The background tool returned terminal exit 0; it does not expose a separate process finish timestamp in its result.

receipt_persistence_qualification.reason: An attempted log-copy command exceeded the tool's 32768-character input limit. No operation was allocated and no command/file write occurred. Public receipt retains exact full untruncated MCP stdout/stderr hashes; existing job logs were preserved.
